title: An easier start on iOS
lede: Create an account with less repetition, then fill in profile details one clear step at a time.

sections.heading: Matched before and after
sections.note: Same iPhone 18 Pro Max, local fixtures, light appearance, default text size, initial scroll, and hidden software keyboard. Captured from separate source snapshots; receipts below.

sections.heading: Recovery and optional photo
sections.note: After-only interaction evidence. Writes are deliberately rejected by the fixture; no real account or profile was changed.

shots.title: Phone save recovery
shots.cap: The phone remains editable after a rejected save.

shots.title: Optional photo
shots.cap: Skip sizes, then finish without a photo or return to sizes.

sections.heading: Larger text
sections.note: After-only Accessibility Large captures. Long forms scroll; the profile footer remains available. This is not a full accessibility audit.

changes.was: Enter and confirm a password; short passwords appear as errors while typing.
changes.now: Enter once, reveal if needed, and see neutral length guidance.

changes.was: Step and field counts compete; actions share a compact row.
changes.now: One step count, a full-width primary action, and explicit optional details.

changes.was: Pasted +1 numbers lose a digit; stale resume hints can introduce hidden steps.
changes.now: Preserve the ten local digits, constrain resume to role-visible steps, and continue in displayed order.

verification: Wisconsin simulator build and 8 native model/draft tests passed.
3 XCTest UI tests passed: password entry/reveal and registration failure, phone save recovery, optional-step navigation.
TypeScript, targeted ESLint, native drift, docs verification, and diff whitespace checks passed.
The phone regression fails against preserved original Swift source: (160) 855-5121 instead of (608) 555-1212.
notes: Local, uncommitted changes only; unrelated work preserved.
Authenticated account creation and durable profile saves are not proven by fixtures. Physical-device AutoFill and photo selection/crop remain unverified.
No time-to-complete claim, production deployment, or TestFlight distribution.
